title: 線性馬達定位平台
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.

stages.title: 行程與力
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成行程與力；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete travel and force through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立負載與行程：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build load and travel requirements: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立負載與行程，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build load and travel requirements through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立負載與行程」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build load and travel requirements disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立負載與行程」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build load and travel requirements, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立負載與行程：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Build load and travel requirements: principle
knowledge.text: 移動質量包含負載、平台與随動電纜，不只是工件重量。
knowledge.textEn: Moving mass includes payload, carriage and moving cables, not the workpiece alone.

knowledge.title: 建立負載與行程：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Build load and travel requirements: evidence
knowledge.text: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。
knowledge.textEn: Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：20 kg 移動負載需 2 m/s² 加速度、外力摩擦共 15 N，理想推力 F=ma+F外=55 N。若此推力占週期 25%、其餘無力，Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N；實際回程與保持力也必須納入。 RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: moving 20 kg at 2 m/s² against 15 N external/friction force requires F=ma+Fexternal=55 N. If this force occupies 25% of a cycle with zero otherwise, Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N. Actual return and holding forces must also be included. RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「線性馬達定位平台」的「建立負載與行程：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Build load and travel requirements: build the model” in “Linear-motor positioning stages”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.failure: 若「控制速度與加加速度」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If control velocity and jerk disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「控制速度與加加速度」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for control velocity and jerk, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：20 kg 移動負載需 2 m/s² 加速度、外力摩擦共 15 N，理想推力 F=ma+F外=55 N。若此推力占週期 25%、其餘無力，Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N；實際回程與保持力也必須納入。 RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: moving 20 kg at 2 m/s² against 15 N external/friction force requires F=ma+Fexternal=55 N. If this force occupies 25% of a cycle with zero otherwise, Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N. Actual return and holding forces must also be included. RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.
